criteria.criterion: Access Coursera Data Science browse/search results without signing in
criteria.final_justification: No adjustment needed: the DOM explicitly confirms access to Coursera Data Science browse/results without a sign-in wall or CAPTCHA, consistent with the baseline score.

criteria.criterion: Apply all requested Coursera filters (Data Science subject, Beginner level, English language, 1–3 months duration) or document unavoidable UI limitations
criteria.final_justification: No adjustment needed: the DOM confirms all requested filters (subject context Data Science + English + Beginner + 1–3 months) are applied; “Courses” is also applied (not harmful). Baseline full credit stands.

criteria.criterion: Identify the three highest-rated matching courses (or report fewer if not available)
criteria.final_justification: Adjust downward: even though the agent listed three real, filter-matching courses, the DOM shows other matching courses with higher (or equal highest) rating than the included 4.6-rated course, so the set is not the three highest-rated. This is a substantive ranking error, not a platform blocker. Keep only minimal partial credit for providing three matching courses with ratings rather than the correct “highest-rated” trio.

criteria.criterion: Report required fields for Course #1 (title, rating, enrollment count if displayed)
criteria.final_justification: Increase from baseline 0: the agent’s Course #1 title and rating match the DOM, and reporting enrollment as unavailable is appropriate because enrollment is not shown on the card.

criteria.criterion: Report required fields for Course #2 (title, rating, enrollment count if displayed)
criteria.final_justification: Increase from baseline 0: regardless of the upstream mistake about “highest-rated” (handled in Criterion 2), the fields the agent reported for Course #2 (title, rating, and enrollment unavailable) are accurate per the DOM.
